1: # CVN Pydantic Generation Pipeline
2: 
3: ## Purpose
4: 
5: This document describes the technical architecture of the CVN generation
6: pipeline and the current structural implementation baseline.
7: 
8: ## Canonical Source Package
9: 
10: The canonical source package is:
11: 
12: ```text
13: docs/CvnXML_v1.4.3_2.1_17012025/
14: |- Leeme.txt
15: |- LeemeENTITY.txt
16: |- LeemeREFERENCETABLES.txt
17: |- LeemeTHESAURUS.txt
18: |- CVN_README.md
19: |- Manual/
20: |  |- Manual de Especificaciones Técnicas v1.4.3_v2.1.pdf
21: |  |- TreeModel_v1.0 20090331 v1.0.pdf
22: |  |- Entidades_esquema_Entity_v1.4.xsd_2008-07-04 v1.0.pdf
23: |  |- ReferenceTables.pdf
24: |  |- Subtypes_v1.1.pdf
25: |  `- Tesauros 2008-01-23 v1.0.pdf
26: |- XML/
27: |  |- SpecificationManual.xml
28: |  |- CVNTreeModel.xml
29: |  |- Entity.xml
30: |  |- ReferenceTables.xml
31: |  |- Subtype_Spa.xml
32: |  |- Thesaurus.xml
33: |  |- Thesaurus_Eng.xml
34: |  `- Thesaurus_Spa.xml
35: `- XSD/
36:    |- CVN.xsd
37:    |- Common.xsd
38:    |- AuxTable.xsd
39:    |- ISOUtilities.xsd
40:    |- SpecificationManual.xsd
41:    |- CVNTreeModel_v1.0.xsd
42:    |- Entity_v1.4.xsd
43:    |- EntityUtilities_v1.4.xsd
44:    |- ISOUtilitiesENTITY.xsd
45:    |- CVNUtilities_v1.0.xsd
46:    |- ReferenceTables.xsd
47:    |- ISOUtilitiesREFERENCETABLES.xsd
48:    |- Subtypes.xsd
49:    |- Thesaurus.xsd
50:    `- ISOUtilitiesTHESAURUS.xsd
51: ```
52: 
53: These artifacts represent three different but related layers, plus a set of
54: auxiliary catalog families that the core CVN package references indirectly.
55: 
56: ### Layer 1 - Final CVN XML Structure
57: 
58: - `XSD/CVN.xsd` defines the XML exchanged by CVN systems
59: - root element: `CVN`
60: - main blocks: `Version`, `Agent`, repeated `CvnItem`
61: 
62: ### Layer 2 - Technical Reusable Types And Controlled Values
63: 
64: - `XSD/Common.xsd` defines wrappers such as `CVN_string`, `CVN_date`,
65:   `CVN_ISO_639`, `CVN_ISO_3166`, and `FlexibleDatesType`
66: - `XSD/AuxTable.xsd` defines CVN auxiliary controlled values
67: - `XSD/ISOUtilities.xsd` defines ISO code tables reused elsewhere
68: 
69: ### Layer 3 - Functional And Technical Metadata
70: 
71: - `XML/SpecificationManual.xml` is the functional manual in XML form
72: - `XML/CVNTreeModel.xml` maps functional CVN codes to technical XML paths
73: - `XSD/SpecificationManual.xsd` validates the manual XML
74: - `XSD/CVNTreeModel_v1.0.xsd` validates the tree model XML
75: 
76: ### Layer 4 - Auxiliary Catalog Families
77: 
78: - `XML/Entity.xml` and `XSD/Entity_v1.4.xsd` define a normalized institution and
79:   organization registry used by CVN through references such as
80:   `ENTITY@Entity.xsd`
81: - `XML/ReferenceTables.xml` and `XSD/ReferenceTables.xsd` materialize a large
82:   portion of the Annex I auxiliary tables in XML form
83: - `XML/Subtype_Spa.xml` and `XSD/Subtypes.xsd` define the codification layer for
84:   `Subtype` values derived from auxiliary tables
85: - `XML/Thesaurus.xml`, `XML/Thesaurus_Eng.xml`, `XML/Thesaurus_Spa.xml`, and
86:   `XSD/Thesaurus.xsd` define the hierarchical keyword thesaurus referenced from
87:   fields such as `THESAURUS@thesaurus.xsd`
88: 
89: ## Observed Relationships Between Files
90: 
91: - `XSD/CVN.xsd` includes `Common.xsd` and `AuxTable.xsd`
92: - `XSD/Common.xsd` includes `ISOUtilities.xsd`
93: - `XSD/SpecificationManual.xsd` imports the CVN namespace for language typing
94: - `XSD/CVNTreeModel_v1.0.xsd` uses its own namespace
95: - `XML/SpecificationManual.xml` is validated by `XSD/SpecificationManual.xsd`
96: - `XML/CVNTreeModel.xml` is validated by `XSD/CVNTreeModel_v1.0.xsd` in
97:   principle, although a documented inconsistency exists in practice
98: - `XML/Entity.xml` is validated by `XSD/Entity_v1.4.xsd` in conceptual terms,
99:   although the preserved repository layout differs from the relative
100:   `schemaLocation` strings used in the original files
101: - `XML/ReferenceTables.xml` is validated by `XSD/ReferenceTables.xsd`
102: - `XML/Subtype_Spa.xml` is validated by `XSD/Subtypes.xsd`
103: - `XML/Thesaurus*.xml` is validated by `XSD/Thesaurus.xsd`
104: 
105: The conceptual relationship is:
106: 
107: ```text
108: SpecificationManual.xml
109:   -> functional meaning of CVN codes
110: 
111: CVNTreeModel.xml
112:   -> technical mapping of those codes into XML nodes and paths
113: 
114: CVN.xsd + Common.xsd + AuxTable.xsd + ISOUtilities.xsd
115:   -> valid XML structure and controlled value types
116: 
117: Entity.xml + Entity_v1.4.xsd + helpers
118:   -> normalized external entity registry used by CVN references
119: 
120: ReferenceTables.xml + ReferenceTables.xsd
121:   -> machine-readable auxiliary tables corresponding to Annex I
122: 
123: Subtype_Spa.xml + Subtypes.xsd
124:   -> codification bridge from auxiliary table values to `Subtype`
125: 
126: Thesaurus.xml + Thesaurus.xsd
127:   -> hierarchical multilingual keyword vocabulary
128: ```
129: 
130: ## Observed Structural Characteristics
131: 
132: ### Complexity Snapshot
133: 
134: - `CVN.xsd`: 74 `complexType`, 232 `element`, 125 `attribute`, 3 `choice`
135: - `Common.xsd`: 11 `complexType`, 1 `choice`
136: - `AuxTable.xsd`: 33 `simpleType`
137: - `ISOUtilities.xsd`: large enumerations for ISO codes
138: 
139: ### Relevant Structural Friction
140: 
141: - recursion through `Link -> CvnItemType`
142: - repeated wrappers using `Item` plus metadata attributes
143: - a small number of important `choice` constructs
144: - very large enums
145: 
146: ### Metadata Coverage
147: 
148: - `SpecificationManual.xml`: 1456 `Item` elements and 1456 unique codes
149: - `CVNTreeModel.xml`: 101 `CVNItem`, 939 `Property`, 4635 `Indicator`
150: - `CVNTreeModel.xml`: 1430 unique codes
151: - overlap between manual and tree model: 1429 codes
152: - codes in manual but not tree model: 27
153: - code in tree model but not manual: `030.010.000.250`
154: 
155: ### Reference Table Situation
156: 
157: Resolvable internally in the core or auxiliary package:
158: 
159: - `ISO_3166`
160: - `ISO_639`
161: - tables in `AuxTable.xsd`
162: - tables in `ReferenceTables.xml`
163: - `UNESCO_CODES`
164: 
165: Available as side-package registries rather than direct core XSD enums:
166: 
167: - `ENTITY@Entity.xsd` -> represented by `Entity_v1.4.xsd` and `Entity.xml`
168: - `THESAURUS@thesaurus.xsd` -> represented by `Thesaurus.xsd` and
169:   `Thesaurus*.xml`
170: 
171: Still unresolved or requiring explicit semantic policy:
172: 
173: - some manual references do not map cleanly to a side-package table from the
174:   package alone, for example `CVN_AGENCY_C`
175: 
176: ## Architecture Decision
177: 
178: The repository uses a two-layer architecture:
179: 
180: ```text
181: Official XSDs
182:   -> structural Pydantic bindings
183: 
184: SpecificationManual.xml + CVNTreeModel.xml
185:   -> normalization
186:   -> semantic mapping rules and overrides
187:   -> domain Pydantic models
188: ```
189: 
190: This means:
191: 
192: - `src/generated/` is an interoperability layer
193: - future semantic cleanup belongs outside `src/generated/`
194: 
195: ### Current Normalization Entry Point
196: 
197: - the recommended repository entry point for normalized metadata is:
198:   - `cvn_codegen.normalization.build_normalization_result(...)`
199: - this entry point returns the integrated normalization layer used by later
200:   roadmap issues, including:
201:   - normalized entries by CVN code
202:   - tree entries by technical XML path
203:   - source-exclusive code sets
204:   - currently documented mismatch reporting
205: - lower-level helper functions inside `cvn_codegen.normalization` remain
206:   importable when needed, but they are not the preferred integration surface for
207:   later stages
208: 
209: ## Repository Layout
210: 
211: ```text
212: src/
213: ├── generated/
214: │   ├── cvn/
215: │   ├── specification_manual/
216: │   └── tree_model/
217: ├── cvn_codegen/
218: └── models/
219:     └── cvn/
220: ```
221: 
222: ### Responsibilities
223: 
224: - `src/generated/`: generated structural bindings
225: - `src/cvn_codegen/`: hand-maintained pipeline logic and generation runner
226: - `src/models/cvn/`: future domain-oriented model output
227: 
228: ## Current Structural Generation Workflow
229: 
230: ### Shared Config
231: 
232: - config file: `config/.xsdata.xml`
233: - package base: `generated`
234: - output format: `pydantic`
235: 
236: ### Standard Runner
237: 
238: - runner module: `src/cvn_codegen/xsdata_runner.py`
239: - supported targets:
240:   - `cvn`
241:   - `specification_manual`
242:   - `tree_model`
243:   - `all`
244: 
245: The runner:
246: 
247: - validates prerequisites
248: - cleans output directories
249: - executes xsdata from `src/`
250: - verifies generated output
251: 
252: ### Target Packages
253: 
254: - `generated.cvn` -> `src/generated/cvn`
255: - `generated.specification_manual` -> `src/generated/specification_manual`
256: - `generated.tree_model` -> `src/generated/tree_model`
257: 
258: ### Target-Specific Override
259: 
260: - `tree_model` uses `--unnest-classes`
261: - reason: avoid generation failure caused by circular dependencies under the
262:   default settings
263: 
264: ## Verification Status
265: 
266: ### Generation
267: 
268: - `CVN.xsd`: generated successfully
269: - `SpecificationManual.xsd`: generated successfully
270: - `CVNTreeModel_v1.0.xsd`: generated successfully with target-specific override
271: 
272: ### Importability
273: 
274: - `generated.cvn`: import OK
275: - `generated.specification_manual`: import OK
276: - `generated.tree_model`: import OK
277: 
278: ### Parse Smoke
279: 
280: - `SpecificationManual.xml`: parse OK
281: - `CVNTreeModel.xml`: parse fails due to source XML/XSD inconsistency, not due
282:   to a broken generated module
283: 
284: ## Known Limitations
285: 
286: See the authoritative limitation register:
287: 
288: - `docs/pipeline/known_limitations.md`

(End of file - total 288 lines)

Perfecto. Ya revisé `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `hotfix-3` y el estado/roadmap/issues implementados y pendientes.

El punto clave es este: **el código implementado (issues `#11-#13`) solo normaliza el núcleo `SpecificationManual + CVNTreeModel`**, mientras que el hotfix `#3` documenta que el paquete canónico real incluye módulos/familias adicionales con peso semántico (`Entity`, `ReferenceTables/Subtypes`, `Thesaurus`, `UNESCO_CODES`).  
Por tanto, el plan actual se quedó corto en ingestión técnica aunque ya esté bien documentado.

**Qué está implementado vs qué falta integrar técnicamente**
- Implementado y estable: infraestructura (`#11`), bindings estructurales core (`#12`), normalización manual/tree (`#13`), CI PR tests (`#25`).
- Pendiente real tras hotfix `#3`: ingestión y resolución machine-readable de referencias de `manual_reference_table` contra `ReferenceTables.xml`, `Subtype_Spa.xml`, `Entity.xml`, `Thesaurus*.xml`.
- Evidencia en código: `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_types.py` solo llega a `manual_reference_table` como string; no existe capa de resolución/catalog classification.
- Evidencia en runner: `src/cvn_codegen/xsdata_runner.py` solo soporta targets `cvn`, `specification_manual`, `tree_model`.

**Modificaciones de código necesarias en issues ya implementadas (retrofit)**
- **Issue `#11` (infraestructura, ajustar alcance real):**
  - Reservar explícitamente paquetes destino adicionales en `src/generated/`: `reference_tables`, `subtypes`, `entity`, `thesaurus` (y opcional `unesco_codes`).
  - Añadir en `src/cvn_codegen/` módulos nuevos para catálogos auxiliares (p.ej. `reference_tables_metadata.py`, `catalog_resolution.py`, `auxiliary_catalog_types.py`).
- **Issue `#12` (bindings estructurales, ampliar targets):**
  - Extender `TARGET_TABLE` y `EXECUTION_ORDER_ALL` en `src/cvn_codegen/xsdata_runner.py` para XSD auxiliares.
  - Añadir overrides por target si alguno falla por dependencias/estructura.
  - Añadir tests unit/smoke equivalentes en `tests/test_xsdata_runner_unit.py` y `tests/test_xsdata_runner_smoke.py` para nuevos targets.
- **Issue `#13` (normalización, ampliar contrato sin romper core):**
  - Extender `ManualCodeEntry`/tipos en `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_types.py` con campos derivados (tipo de referencia, fuente resuelta, patrón de serialización, estado de resolución).
  - Implementar resolución de `manual_reference_table` en `build_normalization_result(...)` (`src/cvn_codegen/normalization.py`) apoyándose en `ReferenceTables.xml` + side packages.
  - Ampliar `NormalizationMismatchKind` y `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_report.py` para:
    - unresolved manual-only (`CVN_AGENCY_C`)
    - technically present but under-traced (`CVN_INTERVENTION_A`, `CVN_PRUEBA`)
    - ambigüedad de mapeo catálogo.
  - Mantener compatibilidad: no romper métricas base actuales (`1457`, `27`, `1`, `1429`), sino añadir una capa de enriquecimiento.
- **Issue `#25` (CI, ajuste menor):**
  - Incluir nuevos tests de resolución/catálogos en el suite que ya corre `uv run pytest tests` (sin cambiar filosofía del workflow).

**Modificaciones de plan para issues no implementadas (replan futuro)**
- **Recomendación fuerte:** insertar una fase puente antes de cerrar `#14` (p.ej. “`#13b` ingestión auxiliar” o ampliar `#14` con etapa 0 técnica).
  - Objetivo: llegar a `#14` con datos resueltos, no solo con strings de tabla.
- **Issue `#14` (semantic mapping rules):**
  - Añadir explícitamente una taxonomía obligatoria por clases de referencia:
    1) enum compacto  
    2) jerárquico  
    3) subtype-backed  
    4) registry externo (`Entity`)

 # Project Guide
 
 ## Purpose
 
 This file is the human entry point for understanding the repository.
 It summarizes the project purpose, the current implementation focus, the
 documentation structure, and the repository rules that matter to contributors
 and maintainers.
 
 ## What This Repository Is
 
 This repository contains a Trabajo de Fin de Grado focused on defining an open
 data schema for representing academic and research CVs in Spain, taking the
 CVN format as the starting point.
 
 The long-term goal is not only to mirror the official CVN package, but to make
 curriculum data easier to validate, transform, store, and export through open
 tooling.
 
 ## Current Technical Scope
 
 The repository is currently centered on the generation pipeline that turns the
 official CVN XML/XSD package into reproducible Python artifacts.
 
 Current and planned layers are:
 
 1. structural bindings generated from the official CVN XML/XSD package
 2. normalized metadata extracted from the official supporting XML documents
 3. semantic mapping rules that recover domain meaning from the structural layer
 4. domain-oriented Pydantic models built over normalized metadata
 
 This means the repository is currently implementing the technical foundation
 for the future parser, validator, JSON-oriented schema, and downstream export
 work. It is not yet the full end-user CV tooling envisioned by the TFG.
 
 ## Recommended Reading Order For Humans
 
 When you need to understand the project state before making changes, read these
 files in order:
 
 1. `PROJECT_GUIDE.md`
 2. `docs/context/project_context_index.md`

+# Hotfix 4 - Structural Scope Correction For Auxiliary Source Package Artifacts
+
+## Summary
+
+Hotfix `#4` records the structural-generation retrofit required after the source
+package documentation expansion from hotfix `#3`.
+
+The repository already implemented the core structural layer for:
+
+- `CVN.xsd`
+- `SpecificationManual.xsd`
+- `CVNTreeModel_v1.0.xsd`
+
+But the canonical package also contains machine-readable auxiliary families that
+were left outside the structural generation plan:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xsd`
+- `Subtypes.xsd`
+- `Entity_v1.4.xsd`
+- `Thesaurus.xsd`
+- repository-derived `UNESCOCodes.xsd`
+
+This hotfix does not implement those changes. It documents exactly how issues
+`#11` and `#12` must be corrected so the repository baseline matches the real
+source package scope.
+
+## Motivation
+
+Hotfix `#3` established that the canonical CVN package is not only the core
+manual, tree model, and CVN XSDs. It also contains auxiliary catalogs and
+supporting schemas that are relevant to later semantic work.
+
+Without this retrofit:
+
+- issue `#14` would define semantic rules over incomplete technical inputs
+- issue `#15` would need to model external catalogs without generated or
+  reproducible structural access to their schemas
+- issue `#16` would test only the core package and leave the auxiliary layer
+  outside regression coverage
+
+## Scope Of This Hotfix
+
+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
+
+It does not itself:
+
+- generate new bindings
+- change `src/generated/`
+- modify runner code
+- modify tests
+
+It defines the required corrective work for already created issues.
+
+## Issues Affected
+
+- issue `#11`
+- issue `#12`
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#11`
+
+Issue `#11` remains valid as the infrastructure baseline, but its documented
+scope must be expanded so the reserved repository layout matches the canonical
+package.
+
+### Repository Layout Changes Required
+
+The infrastructure documentation and intended layout must explicitly reserve
+destination packages for the auxiliary structural families under
+`src/generated/`.
+
+At minimum, the repository must treat these as planned generated packages:
+
+- `src/generated/reference_tables/`
+- `src/generated/subtypes/`
+- `src/generated/entity/`
+- `src/generated/thesaurus/`
+
+Optional but recommended if the isolated extracted artifact remains part of the
+repository contract:
+
+- `src/generated/unesco_codes/`
+
+### Hand-Maintained Pipeline Areas Required
+
+Issue `#11` should also be retroactively understood as reserving space for
+hand-maintained support logic dedicated to auxiliary artifacts under
+`src/cvn_codegen/`.
+
+The expected future module families are:
+
+- structural loading helpers for auxiliary XML/XSD families
+- resolution helpers that connect `manual_reference_table` values to their
+  backing artifacts
+- normalization or indexing helpers for side-package catalogs
+
+### Documentation Changes Required
+
+Issue `#11` should be updated so its repository layout and future-impact section
+explicitly state that the infrastructure baseline must support both:
+
+- core structural bindings
+- auxiliary catalog structural bindings
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#12`
+
+Issue `#12` is the main issue that needs corrective scope expansion.
+
+Its current plan generated structural bindings only for the three core XSD
+concerns. The corrected scope must cover the auxiliary schemas that carry
+machine-readable catalog semantics.
+
+### New Generation Targets Required
+
+`src/cvn_codegen/xsdata_runner.py` must be extended so `TARGET_TABLE` and the
+supported target list include at least:
+
+- `reference_tables`
+- `subtypes`
+- `entity`
+- `thesaurus`
+
+Optional but recommended if treated as a first-class repository artifact:
+
+- `unesco_codes`
+
+### Expected Target Mapping
+
+The corrected target mapping should follow this pattern:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xsd` -> `generated.reference_tables`
+- `Subtypes.xsd` -> `generated.subtypes`
+- `Entity_v1.4.xsd` -> `generated.entity`
+- `Thesaurus.xsd` -> `generated.thesaurus`
+- `UNESCOCodes.xsd` -> `generated.unesco_codes`
+
+### Runner Changes Required
+
+The runner correction must include:
+
+1. add the new targets to `TARGET_TABLE`
+2. extend the stable execution order used by `all`
+3. add per-target overrides only when a schema actually needs one
+4. preserve the current safety checks for output directories
+5. keep generation reproducible from `src/`
+
+### Verification Changes Required
+
+Issue `#12` must expand its verification section so it no longer stops at the
+three core packages.
+
+The corrected verification must include:
+
+1. import checks for the new generated packages
+2. smoke parsing where feasible for:
+   - `ReferenceTables.xml`
+   - `Subtype_Spa.xml`
+   - `Entity.xml`
+   - `Thesaurus.xml`
+3. documented exceptions when preserved repository layout or source-package
+   drift blocks direct parse success
+
+### Test Changes Required
+
+The following existing test modules must be expanded:
+
+- `tests/test_xsdata_runner_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_xsdata_runner_smoke.py`
+
+The corrected tests must verify:
+
+1. the new target names are resolvable
+2. the runner command is built correctly for each new target
+3. generation produces Python files for at least one auxiliary target in smoke
+   coverage
+4. failures caused by documented source-package drift are recorded as known
+   behavior, not hidden
+
+### Issue `#12` Documentation Corrections Required
+
+The issue document for `#12` must be updated so it clearly distinguishes:
+
+- core structural bindings already implemented
+- auxiliary structural bindings still missing but now required by corrected scope
+
+Its impact-on-future-issues section must also state that later semantic work
+depends on both core and auxiliary structural visibility.
+
+## Files Expected To Change When Applying This Hotfix
+
+When hotfix `#4` is implemented for real, the minimum expected file set is:
+
+- `src/cvn_codegen/xsdata_runner.py`
+- `tests/test_xsdata_runner_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_xsdata_runner_smoke.py`
+- `docs/roadmap/issues/issue-11-project-infrastructure.md`
+- `docs/roadmap/issues/issue-12-structural-bindings.md`
+- `docs/context/current_status.md`
+- `docs/roadmap/cvn_generation_roadmap.md`
+- `docs/pipeline/cvn_pydantic_generation_pipeline.md`
+- `PROJECT_GUIDE.md` if the visible repository layout summary changes
+
+## Verification Strategy When Implemented
+
+The implementation session that applies this hotfix should verify at minimum:
+
+1. `uv run pytest tests/test_xsdata_runner_unit.py -v`
+2. `uv run pytest tests/test_xsdata_runner_smoke.py -v`
+3. direct import of all generated auxiliary packages
+4. any successful auxiliary parse smoke checks that the preserved package layout
+   allows
+
+## Impact On Future Issues
+
+- issue `#13` can no longer be treated as the final technical input boundary for
+  semantic work
+- issue `#14` should assume structural visibility of the auxiliary families, not
+  only prose documentation about them
+- issue `#16` must include regression coverage for auxiliary-target generation
+- issue `#17` must document the full target set in the regeneration workflow
+
+## Status
+
+- Status: documented as required corrective work
+- Implementation state: pending

+# Hotfix 5 - Normalization Resolution Layer For Auxiliary Reference Sources
+
+## Summary
+
+Hotfix `#5` records the normalization retrofit required after hotfix `#3`
+showed that `ManualCodeEntry.manual_reference_table` points to several kinds of
+machine-readable sources, not only to opaque strings awaiting later manual
+interpretation.
+
+Issue `#13` successfully normalized `SpecificationManual.xml` and
+`CVNTreeModel.xml`, but it deliberately stopped before resolving the technical
+backing of manual reference tables against:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- `Subtype_Spa.xml`
+- `Entity.xml`
+- `Thesaurus*.xml`
+- repository-derived `UNESCO_CODES.xml`
+
+This hotfix documents exactly how issue `#13` must be extended without breaking
+its already validated core baseline.
+
+## Motivation
+
+The current normalization layer is structurally correct but semantically too
+shallow for the updated repository understanding.
+
+Today the code extracts:
+
+- `manual_reference_table`
+
+But it does not yet compute:
+
+- whether that reference resolves to `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- whether it is subtype-backed through `Subtypes.xsd`
+- whether it points to a side-package registry such as `Entity`
+- whether it points to a thesaurus
+- whether it is unresolved from the package alone
+
+That gap would force issue `#14` to rebuild source resolution logic from scratch
+instead of consuming a stable normalized layer.
+
+## Scope Of This Hotfix
+
+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
+
+It does not itself:
+
+- modify normalization code
+- change tests
+- add new runtime behavior
+
+It defines the required corrective work for issue `#13`.
+
+## Issues Affected
+
+- issue `#13`
+

+# Hotfix 6 - Roadmap Realignment For Auxiliary Catalog Semantic Integration

+## Summary
+

+The original roadmap for issues `#14` to `#17` assumed that the repository would
+reach semantic work after only two technical preparation stages:

+1. structural bindings for the core schemas
+2. normalization of `SpecificationManual.xml` and `CVNTreeModel.xml`

+After the auxiliary source-package analysis from hotfix `#3`, that sequencing is
+no longer sufficient. Future issues must explicitly incorporate the auxiliary
+catalog families and the resolution layer built over them.

+This hotfix does not implement those future issues. It documents exactly how the
+already created issue set must be replanned.

+## Motivation
+

+  inputs

+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.

+It does not itself:

+- implement issue `#14`
+- implement issue `#15`
+- implement issue `#16`
+- implement issue `#17`

+documents that describe them.

+2. core normalization of manual and tree sources
+3. auxiliary reference-resolution enrichment over normalized manual references
+
+The epic current-status section must also stop saying that issue `#13` is the
+next planned issue.

+4. scope table

+# Hotfix 4 - Structural Scope Correction For Auxiliary Source Package Artifacts
+
+## Summary
+
+Hotfix `#4` records the structural-generation retrofit required after the source
+package documentation expansion from hotfix `#3`.
+
+The repository already implemented the core structural layer for:
+
+- `CVN.xsd`
+- `SpecificationManual.xsd`
+- `CVNTreeModel_v1.0.xsd`
+
+But the canonical package also contains machine-readable auxiliary families that
+were left outside the structural generation plan:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xsd`
+- `Subtypes.xsd`
+- `Entity_v1.4.xsd`
+- `Thesaurus.xsd`
+- repository-derived `UNESCOCodes.xsd`
+
+This hotfix does not implement those changes. It documents exactly how issues
+`#11` and `#12` must be corrected so the repository baseline matches the real
+source package scope.
+
+## Motivation
+
+Hotfix `#3` established that the canonical CVN package is not only the core
+manual, tree model, and CVN XSDs. It also contains auxiliary catalogs and
+supporting schemas that are relevant to later semantic work.
+
+Without this retrofit:
+
+- issue `#14` would define semantic rules over incomplete technical inputs
+- issue `#15` would need to model external catalogs without generated or
+  reproducible structural access to their schemas
+- issue `#16` would test only the core package and leave the auxiliary layer
+  outside regression coverage
+
+## Scope Of This Hotfix
+
+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
+
+It does not itself:
+
+- generate new bindings
+- change `src/generated/`
+- modify runner code
+- modify tests
+
+It defines the required corrective work for already created issues.
+
+## Issues Affected
+
+- issue `#11`
+- issue `#12`
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#11`
+
+Issue `#11` remains valid as the infrastructure baseline, but its documented
+scope must be expanded so the reserved repository layout matches the canonical
+package.
+
+### Repository Layout Changes Required
+
+The infrastructure documentation and intended layout must explicitly reserve
+destination packages for the auxiliary structural families under
+`src/generated/`.
+
+At minimum, the repository must treat these as planned generated packages:
+
+- `src/generated/reference_tables/`
+- `src/generated/subtypes/`
+- `src/generated/entity/`
+- `src/generated/thesaurus/`
+
+Optional but recommended if the isolated extracted artifact remains part of the
+repository contract:
+
+- `src/generated/unesco_codes/`
+
+### Hand-Maintained Pipeline Areas Required
+
+Issue `#11` should also be retroactively understood as reserving space for
+hand-maintained support logic dedicated to auxiliary artifacts under
+`src/cvn_codegen/`.
+
+The expected future module families are:
+
+- structural loading helpers for auxiliary XML/XSD families
+- resolution helpers that connect `manual_reference_table` values to their
+  backing artifacts
+- normalization or indexing helpers for side-package catalogs
+
+### Documentation Changes Required
+
+Issue `#11` should be updated so its repository layout and future-impact section
+explicitly state that the infrastructure baseline must support both:
+
+- core structural bindings
+- auxiliary catalog structural bindings
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#12`
+
+Issue `#12` is the main issue that needs corrective scope expansion.
+
+Its current plan generated structural bindings only for the three core XSD
+concerns. The corrected scope must cover the auxiliary schemas that carry
+machine-readable catalog semantics.
+
+### New Generation Targets Required
+
+`src/cvn_codegen/xsdata_runner.py` must be extended so `TARGET_TABLE` and the
+supported target list include at least:
+
+- `reference_tables`
+- `subtypes`
+- `entity`
+- `thesaurus`
+
+Optional but recommended if treated as a first-class repository artifact:
+
+- `unesco_codes`
+
+### Expected Target Mapping

+The corrected target mapping should follow this pattern:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xsd` -> `generated.reference_tables`
+- `Subtypes.xsd` -> `generated.subtypes`
+- `Entity_v1.4.xsd` -> `generated.entity`
+- `Thesaurus.xsd` -> `generated.thesaurus`
+- `UNESCOCodes.xsd` -> `generated.unesco_codes`

+### Runner Changes Required

+
+1. add the new targets to `TARGET_TABLE`

+### Verification Changes Required

+The corrected verification must include:
+
+1. import checks for the new generated packages
+2. smoke parsing where feasible for:
+   - `ReferenceTables.xml`
+   - `Subtype_Spa.xml`
+   - `Entity.xml`
+   - `Thesaurus.xml`
+3. documented exceptions when preserved repository layout or source-package
+   drift blocks direct parse success
+
+### Test Changes Required
+
+The following existing test modules must be expanded:
+
+- `tests/test_xsdata_runner_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_xsdata_runner_smoke.py`
+
+The corrected tests must verify:

+1. the new target names are resolvable

+### Issue `#12` Documentation Corrections Required

+## Verification Strategy When Implemented

+The implementation session that applies this hotfix should verify at minimum:
+
+1. `uv run pytest tests/test_xsdata_runner_unit.py -v`
+2. `uv run pytest tests/test_xsdata_runner_smoke.py -v`
+3. direct import of all generated auxiliary packages
+4. any successful auxiliary parse smoke checks that the preserved package layout
+   allows
+
+## Impact On Future Issues
+
+- issue `#13` can no longer be treated as the final technical input boundary for
+  semantic work
+- issue `#14` should assume structural visibility of the auxiliary families, not
+  only prose documentation about them
+- issue `#16` must include regression coverage for auxiliary-target generation
+- issue `#17` must document the full target set in the regeneration workflow
+
+## Status

+- Status: documented as required corrective work

+# Hotfix 5 - Normalization Resolution Layer For Auxiliary Reference Sources
+
+## Summary
+
+Hotfix `#5` records the normalization retrofit required after hotfix `#3`
+showed that `ManualCodeEntry.manual_reference_table` points to several kinds of
+machine-readable sources, not only to opaque strings awaiting later manual
+interpretation.
+
+Issue `#13` successfully normalized `SpecificationManual.xml` and
+`CVNTreeModel.xml`, but it deliberately stopped before resolving the technical
+backing of manual reference tables against:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- `Subtype_Spa.xml`
+- `Entity.xml`
+- `Thesaurus*.xml`
+- repository-derived `UNESCO_CODES.xml`
+
+This hotfix documents exactly how issue `#13` must be extended without breaking
+its already validated core baseline.
+
+## Motivation
+
+The current normalization layer is structurally correct but semantically too
+shallow for the updated repository understanding.
+
+Today the code extracts:
+
+- `manual_reference_table`
+
+But it does not yet compute:
+
+- whether that reference resolves to `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- whether it is subtype-backed through `Subtypes.xsd`
+- whether it points to a side-package registry such as `Entity`
+- whether it points to a thesaurus
+- whether it is unresolved from the package alone
+
+That gap would force issue `#14` to rebuild source resolution logic from scratch
+instead of consuming a stable normalized layer.
+
+## Scope Of This Hotfix
+
+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
+
+It does not itself:
+
+- modify normalization code
+- change tests
+- add new runtime behavior
+
+It defines the required corrective work for issue `#13`.
+
+## Issues Affected
+
+- issue `#13`
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#13`
+
+Issue `#13` should remain marked as completed for the core normalization layer,
+but its document and implementation plan must now be expanded to include an
+additive resolution layer over auxiliary references.
+
+### Contract Changes Required
+
+The normalization contract in `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_types.py` must be
+extended with additive fields rather than by replacing the current structures.
+
+At minimum, the normalization output needs a typed representation for:
+
+1. reference resolution status
+2. resolved source family
+3. resolved source artifact name
+4. serialization pattern classification
+5. semantic reference kind
+6. subtype-backing flag or subtype metadata
+
+The design must preserve backward compatibility for current consumers of:
+
+- `ManualCodeEntry`
+- `NormalizedCodeEntry`
+- `NormalizationResult`
+
+### New Types Required
+
+Issue `#13` should add typed structures equivalent in intent to the following:
+
+- a reference-source enum or constrained type
+- a serialization-pattern enum or constrained type
+- a reference-resolution record attached to manual entries or normalized entries
+
+The exact names may vary, but the contract must support these categories:
+
+1. direct `ReferenceTables` table
+2. subtype-backed table
+3. side-package registry
+4. side-package thesaurus
+5. hierarchical thematic table
+6. unresolved manual-only reference
+7. technically present but under-traced table
+
+### New Hand-Maintained Modules Required
+
+Issue `#13` currently spreads normalization across a small flat set of modules.
+That remains acceptable, but the following new responsibilities must be added
+under `src/cvn_codegen/`:
+
+- loading and indexing of `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- loading and indexing of `Subtype_Spa.xml`
+- loading and indexing of `Entity.xml` where needed for source classification
+- loading and indexing of `Thesaurus*.xml` where needed for source
+  classification
+- resolution of `manual_reference_table` against those sources
+- classification of serialization patterns from machine-readable metadata
+
+This can be implemented either as new dedicated modules or as a small
+subpackage, but the logic must stay outside `src/generated/`.
+
+### Orchestration Changes Required
+
+`build_normalization_result(...)` in `src/cvn_codegen/normalization.py` must be
+expanded so the final normalized result includes auxiliary-reference resolution.
+
+The corrected orchestration must:
+
+1. keep the current code-overlap logic unchanged
+2. keep the current `xml_path` logic unchanged
+3. build auxiliary indexes from machine-readable source files
+4. resolve each `manual_reference_table` deterministically
+5. attach the resolution result to the normalized output
+6. preserve source traceability for every resolved reference
+
+### Mismatch And Limitation Reporting Changes Required
+
+`src/cvn_codegen/normalization_report.py` and
+`NormalizationMismatchKind` must be extended so the normalization layer can
+explicitly report the new source-resolution findings.
+
+At minimum, the corrected mismatch taxonomy must support:
+
+- unresolved manual reference
+- ambiguous auxiliary resolution
+- subtype-backed reference lacking expected subtype support
+- technically present but under-traced table
+
+Known repository cases that must be represented explicitly:
+
+- `CVN_AGENCY_C` as unresolved manual-only reference
+- `CVN_INTERVENTION_A` as technically present but currently under-traced
+- `CVN_PRUEBA` as technically present but currently under-traced
+
+### Test Changes Required
+
+The following current tests must be expanded or complemented:
+
+- `tests/test_manual_metadata_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_normalization_report_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_normalization_unit.py`
+
+The corrected test scope must verify at minimum:
+
+1. direct table resolution from `manual_reference_table`
+2. recognition of subtype-backed tables
+3. recognition of side-package registry references
+4. recognition of thesaurus references
+5. unresolved manual-only classification
+6. preservation of the current overlap baseline counts from issue `#13`
+
+### Documentation Corrections Required For Issue `#13`

+The issue document for `#13` must be updated so it clearly distinguishes two

+3. `uv run pytest tests/test_normalization_unit.py -v`

+# Hotfix 4 - Structural Scope Correction For Auxiliary Source Package Artifacts
+
+## Summary
+
+Hotfix `#4` records the structural-generation retrofit required after the source
+package documentation expansion from hotfix `#3`.
+
+The repository already implemented the core structural layer for:
+
+- `CVN.xsd`
+- `SpecificationManual.xsd`
+- `CVNTreeModel_v1.0.xsd`
+
+But the canonical package also contains machine-readable auxiliary families that
+were left outside the structural generation plan:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xsd`
+- `Subtypes.xsd`
+- `Entity_v1.4.xsd`
+- `Thesaurus.xsd`
+- repository-derived `UNESCOCodes.xsd`
+
+This hotfix does not implement those changes. It documents exactly how issues
+`#11` and `#12` must be corrected so the repository baseline matches the real
+source package scope.
+
+## Motivation
+
+Hotfix `#3` established that the canonical CVN package is not only the core
+manual, tree model, and CVN XSDs. It also contains auxiliary catalogs and
+supporting schemas that are relevant to later semantic work.
+
+Without this retrofit:
+
+- issue `#14` would define semantic rules over incomplete technical inputs
+- issue `#15` would need to model external catalogs without generated or
+  reproducible structural access to their schemas
+- issue `#16` would test only the core package and leave the auxiliary layer
+  outside regression coverage
+
+## Scope Of This Hotfix
+
+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
+
+It does not itself:
+
+- generate new bindings
+- change `src/generated/`
+- modify runner code
+- modify tests
+
+It defines the required corrective work for already created issues.
+
+## Issues Affected
+
+- issue `#11`
+- issue `#12`
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#11`
+
+Issue `#11` remains valid as the infrastructure baseline, but its documented
+scope must be expanded so the reserved repository layout matches the canonical
+package.
+
+### Repository Layout Changes Required
+
+The infrastructure documentation and intended layout must explicitly reserve
+destination packages for the auxiliary structural families under
+`src/generated/`.
+
+At minimum, the repository must treat these as planned generated packages:
+
+- `src/generated/reference_tables/`
+- `src/generated/subtypes/`
+- `src/generated/entity/`
+- `src/generated/thesaurus/`

+Optional but recommended if the isolated extracted artifact remains part of the
+repository contract:

+### Hand-Maintained Pipeline Areas Required

+Issue `#11` should also be retroactively understood as reserving space for
+hand-maintained support logic dedicated to auxiliary artifacts under
+`src/cvn_codegen/`.
+
+The expected future module families are:
+
+- structural loading helpers for auxiliary XML/XSD families
+- resolution helpers that connect `manual_reference_table` values to their
+  backing artifacts
+- normalization or indexing helpers for side-package catalogs
+
+### Documentation Changes Required
+
+Issue `#11` should be updated so its repository layout and future-impact section
+explicitly state that the infrastructure baseline must support both:

+- core structural bindings
+- auxiliary catalog structural bindings
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#12`

+Issue `#12` is the main issue that needs corrective scope expansion.

+# Hotfix 5 - Normalization Resolution Layer For Auxiliary Reference Sources
+
+## Summary
+
+Hotfix `#5` records the normalization retrofit required after hotfix `#3`
+showed that `ManualCodeEntry.manual_reference_table` points to several kinds of
+machine-readable sources, not only to opaque strings awaiting later manual
+interpretation.
+
+Issue `#13` successfully normalized `SpecificationManual.xml` and
+`CVNTreeModel.xml`, but it deliberately stopped before resolving the technical
+backing of manual reference tables against:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- `Subtype_Spa.xml`
+- `Entity.xml`
+- `Thesaurus*.xml`
+- repository-derived `UNESCO_CODES.xml`
+
+This hotfix documents exactly how issue `#13` must be extended without breaking
+its already validated core baseline.
+
+## Motivation
+
+The current normalization layer is structurally correct but semantically too
+shallow for the updated repository understanding.
+
+Today the code extracts:
+
+- `manual_reference_table`
+
+But it does not yet compute:
+
+- whether that reference resolves to `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- whether it is subtype-backed through `Subtypes.xsd`
+- whether it points to a side-package registry such as `Entity`
+- whether it points to a thesaurus
+- whether it is unresolved from the package alone
+
+That gap would force issue `#14` to rebuild source resolution logic from scratch
+instead of consuming a stable normalized layer.
+
+## Scope Of This Hotfix
+
+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
+
+It does not itself:
+
+- modify normalization code
+- change tests
+- add new runtime behavior
+
+It defines the required corrective work for issue `#13`.
+
+## Issues Affected
+
+- issue `#13`
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#13`
+
+Issue `#13` should remain marked as completed for the core normalization layer,
+but its document and implementation plan must now be expanded to include an
+additive resolution layer over auxiliary references.
+
+### Contract Changes Required
+
+The normalization contract in `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_types.py` must be
+extended with additive fields rather than by replacing the current structures.
+
+At minimum, the normalization output needs a typed representation for:
+
+1. reference resolution status
+2. resolved source family
+3. resolved source artifact name
+4. serialization pattern classification
+5. semantic reference kind
+6. subtype-backing flag or subtype metadata
+
+The design must preserve backward compatibility for current consumers of:
+
+- `ManualCodeEntry`
+- `NormalizedCodeEntry`
+- `NormalizationResult`
+
+### New Types Required
+
+Issue `#13` should add typed structures equivalent in intent to the following:
+
+- a reference-source enum or constrained type
+- a serialization-pattern enum or constrained type
+- a reference-resolution record attached to manual entries or normalized entries
+
+The exact names may vary, but the contract must support these categories:
+
+1. direct `ReferenceTables` table
+2. subtype-backed table
+3. side-package registry
+4. side-package thesaurus
+5. hierarchical thematic table
+6. unresolved manual-only reference
+7. technically present but under-traced table
+
+### New Hand-Maintained Modules Required
+
+Issue `#13` currently spreads normalization across a small flat set of modules.
+That remains acceptable, but the following new responsibilities must be added
+under `src/cvn_codegen/`:
+
+- loading and indexing of `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- loading and indexing of `Subtype_Spa.xml`
+- loading and indexing of `Entity.xml` where needed for source classification
+- loading and indexing of `Thesaurus*.xml` where needed for source
+  classification
+- resolution of `manual_reference_table` against those sources
+- classification of serialization patterns from machine-readable metadata
+
+This can be implemented either as new dedicated modules or as a small
+subpackage, but the logic must stay outside `src/generated/`.
+
+### Orchestration Changes Required
+
+`build_normalization_result(...)` in `src/cvn_codegen/normalization.py` must be
+expanded so the final normalized result includes auxiliary-reference resolution.
+
+The corrected orchestration must:
+
+1. keep the current code-overlap logic unchanged
+2. keep the current `xml_path` logic unchanged
+3. build auxiliary indexes from machine-readable source files
+4. resolve each `manual_reference_table` deterministically
+5. attach the resolution result to the normalized output
+6. preserve source traceability for every resolved reference
+
+### Mismatch And Limitation Reporting Changes Required
+
+`src/cvn_codegen/normalization_report.py` and
+`NormalizationMismatchKind` must be extended so the normalization layer can
+explicitly report the new source-resolution findings.
+
+At minimum, the corrected mismatch taxonomy must support:
+
+- unresolved manual reference
+- ambiguous auxiliary resolution
+- subtype-backed reference lacking expected subtype support
+- technically present but under-traced table
+
+Known repository cases that must be represented explicitly:
+
+- `CVN_AGENCY_C` as unresolved manual-only reference
+- `CVN_INTERVENTION_A` as technically present but currently under-traced
+- `CVN_PRUEBA` as technically present but currently under-traced
+
+### Test Changes Required
+
+The following current tests must be expanded or complemented:
+
+- `tests/test_manual_metadata_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_normalization_report_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_normalization_unit.py`
+
+The corrected test scope must verify at minimum:
+
+1. direct table resolution from `manual_reference_table`
+2. recognition of subtype-backed tables
+3. recognition of side-package registry references
+4. recognition of thesaurus references
+5. unresolved manual-only classification
+6. preservation of the current overlap baseline counts from issue `#13`
+
+### Documentation Corrections Required For Issue `#13`
+
+The issue document for `#13` must be updated so it clearly distinguishes two
+layers:
+
+1. completed core normalization of manual/tree sources
+2. pending auxiliary-reference resolution enrichment required by hotfix `#5`
+
+The issue must no longer imply that `manual_reference_table` is sufficient as a
+final semantic input by itself.
+
+## Files Expected To Change When Applying This Hotfix
+
+When hotfix `#5` is implemented for real, the minimum expected file set is:
+
+- `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_types.py`
+- `src/cvn_codegen/normalization.py`
+- `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_report.py`
+- one or more new modules under `src/cvn_codegen/` for auxiliary-source loading

+- `tests/test_manual_metadata_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_normalization_report_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_normalization_unit.py`
+- `docs/roadmap/issues/issue-13-normalization.md`
+- `docs/context/current_status.md`
+- `docs/roadmap/cvn_generation_roadmap.md`
+- `docs/pipeline/known_limitations.md` if new resolution limits are discovered
+
+## Verification Strategy When Implemented
+
+The implementation session that applies this hotfix should verify at minimum:
+
+1. `uv run pytest tests/test_manual_metadata_unit.py -v`
+2. `uv run pytest tests/test_normalization_report_unit.py -v`
+3. `uv run pytest tests/test_normalization_unit.py -v`
+4. preservation of the validated baseline counts from issue `#13`
+5. correct classification of the documented special cases from hotfix `#3`
+
+## Impact On Future Issues
+
+- issue `#14` should consume resolved auxiliary-reference metadata instead of
+  re-deriving the source-of-truth rules from prose documents
+- issue `#15` can generate different domain shapes for enums, registries,
+  thesauri, and subtype-backed families from normalized data rather than from ad
+  hoc logic
+- issue `#16` must include regression tests for reference-resolution behavior
+- issue `#17` must document normalization as a richer stage than simple manual
+  and tree cross-indexing
+

+
+- Status: documented as required corrective work
+- Implementation state: pending

+# Hotfix 6 - Roadmap Realignment For Auxiliary Catalog Semantic Integration
+
+## Summary
+
+Hotfix `#6` records the roadmap correction required after hotfixes `#4` and
+`#5`.
+
+The original roadmap for issues `#14` to `#17` assumed that the repository would
+reach semantic work after only two technical preparation stages:
+
+1. structural bindings for the core schemas
+2. normalization of `SpecificationManual.xml` and `CVNTreeModel.xml`
+
+After the auxiliary source-package analysis from hotfix `#3`, that sequencing is
+no longer sufficient. Future issues must explicitly incorporate the auxiliary
+catalog families and the resolution layer built over them.
+
+This hotfix does not implement those future issues. It documents exactly how the
+already created issue set must be replanned.
+
+## Motivation
+
+If the roadmap is left unchanged:
+
+- issue `#14` would try to define semantic policy over incomplete normalized
+  inputs
+- issue `#15` would likely mix discovery work with generation work
+- issue `#16` would test a pipeline that still lacks the now-documented
+  auxiliary-source integration stage
+- issue `#17` would document an incomplete workflow
+
+## Scope Of This Hotfix
+
+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
+
+It does not itself:
+
+- implement issue `#14`
+- implement issue `#15`
+- implement issue `#16`
+- implement issue `#17`
+
+It defines the required replanning for those issues and for the roadmap-level
+documents that describe them.
+
+## Issues Affected
+
+- issue `#8`
+- issue `#14`
+- issue `#15`
+- issue `#16`
+- issue `#17`
+- issue `#25` as CI impact only
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#8`
+
+The epic summary in issue `#8` must be updated because its current state and
+integration checkpoints are historically outdated.
+
+The corrected epic narrative must state that the technical foundation now has
+three preparation layers before domain-model generation can proceed safely:
+
+1. core and auxiliary structural bindings
+2. core normalization of manual and tree sources
+3. auxiliary reference-resolution enrichment over normalized manual references
+
+The epic current-status section must also stop saying that issue `#13` is the
+next planned issue.
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#14`
+
+Issue `#14` needs the largest scope correction among pending issues.
+
+### New Required Input Assumption
+
+Issue `#14` must no longer assume that semantic policy begins from only:
+
+- manual type
+- multiplicity
+- `manual_reference_table`
+- `xml_path`
+
+It must now explicitly consume the enriched normalization output from hotfix
+`#5`, including resolved source family and serialization-pattern metadata.
+
+### New Decision Areas Required
+
+The issue plan for `#14` must explicitly classify references into at least these
+semantic kinds:
+
+1. compact enum-like table
+2. compact scale or measure table
+3. identifier-type table
+4. scope table
+5. subtype-backed controlled family
+6. hierarchical thematic classification
+7. side-package registry
+8. side-package thesaurus or vocabulary
+9. unresolved manual-only reference
+10. technically present but under-traced table
+
+### New Policy Outputs Required
+
+The final semantic policy for issue `#14` must define:
+
+1. open versus closed treatment per reference kind
+2. enum eligibility rules
+3. registry-reference treatment for `Entity`
+4. hierarchical vocabulary treatment for `Thesaurus` and `UNESCO_CODES`
+5. subtype-backed treatment for `Subtype@Subtypes.xsd`
+6. fallback policy for unresolved references such as `CVN_AGENCY_C`
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#15`
+
+Issue `#15` must be replanned so it does not flatten all controlled references
+into the same generation strategy.
+
+### New Generator Responsibilities Required
+
+The generator design for `#15` must support distinct domain representations for:
+
+1. strict enums or near-enums
+2. open coded values
+3. structured external registry references
+4. hierarchical subject or thesaurus references
+5. subtype-backed values with traceability to subtype codification
+6. unresolved references that must remain explicit in the domain layer
+

+# Hotfix 4 - Structural Scope Correction For Auxiliary Source Package Artifacts
+
+## Summary
+
+Hotfix `#4` records the structural-generation retrofit required after the source
+package documentation expansion from hotfix `#3`.
+
+The repository already implemented the core structural layer for:
+
+- `CVN.xsd`
+- `SpecificationManual.xsd`
+- `CVNTreeModel_v1.0.xsd`
+
+But the canonical package also contains machine-readable auxiliary families that
+were left outside the structural generation plan:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xsd`
+- `Subtypes.xsd`
+- `Entity_v1.4.xsd`
+- `Thesaurus.xsd`
+- repository-derived `UNESCOCodes.xsd`
+
+This hotfix does not implement those changes. It documents exactly how issues
+`#11` and `#12` must be corrected so the repository baseline matches the real
+source package scope.
+
+## Motivation
+
+Hotfix `#3` established that the canonical CVN package is not only the core
+manual, tree model, and CVN XSDs. It also contains auxiliary catalogs and
+supporting schemas that are relevant to later semantic work.
+
+Without this retrofit:
+
+- issue `#14` would define semantic rules over incomplete technical inputs
+- issue `#15` would need to model external catalogs without generated or
+  reproducible structural access to their schemas
+- issue `#16` would test only the core package and leave the auxiliary layer
+  outside regression coverage
+
+## Scope Of This Hotfix
+
+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
+
+It does not itself:
+
+- generate new bindings
+- change `src/generated/`
+- modify runner code
+- modify tests
+
+It defines the required corrective work for already created issues.
+
+## Issues Affected
+
+- issue `#11`
+- issue `#12`
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#11`
+
+Issue `#11` remains valid as the infrastructure baseline, but its documented
+scope must be expanded so the reserved repository layout matches the canonical
+package.
+
+### Repository Layout Changes Required
+
+The infrastructure documentation and intended layout must explicitly reserve
+destination packages for the auxiliary structural families under
+`src/generated/`.
+
+At minimum, the repository must treat these as planned generated packages:
+
+- `src/generated/reference_tables/`
+- `src/generated/subtypes/`
+- `src/generated/entity/`
+- `src/generated/thesaurus/`
+
+Optional but recommended if the isolated extracted artifact remains part of the
+repository contract:
+
+- `src/generated/unesco_codes/`
+
+### Hand-Maintained Pipeline Areas Required
+
+Issue `#11` should also be retroactively understood as reserving space for
+hand-maintained support logic dedicated to auxiliary artifacts under
+`src/cvn_codegen/`.
+
+The expected future module families are:
+
+- structural loading helpers for auxiliary XML/XSD families
+- resolution helpers that connect `manual_reference_table` values to their
+  backing artifacts
+- normalization or indexing helpers for side-package catalogs
+
+### Documentation Changes Required
+
+Issue `#11` should be updated so its repository layout and future-impact section
+explicitly state that the infrastructure baseline must support both:
+
+- core structural bindings
+- auxiliary catalog structural bindings
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#12`
+
+Issue `#12` is the main issue that needs corrective scope expansion.
+
+Its current plan generated structural bindings only for the three core XSD
+concerns. The corrected scope must cover the auxiliary schemas that carry
+machine-readable catalog semantics.
+
+### New Generation Targets Required
+
+`src/cvn_codegen/xsdata_runner.py` must be extended so `TARGET_TABLE` and the
+supported target list include at least:
+
+- `reference_tables`
+- `subtypes`
+- `entity`
+- `thesaurus`
+
+Optional but recommended if treated as a first-class repository artifact:
+
+- `unesco_codes`
+
+### Expected Target Mapping
+
+The corrected target mapping should follow this pattern:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xsd` -> `generated.reference_tables`
+- `Subtypes.xsd` -> `generated.subtypes`
+- `Entity_v1.4.xsd` -> `generated.entity`
+- `Thesaurus.xsd` -> `generated.thesaurus`
+- `UNESCOCodes.xsd` -> `generated.unesco_codes`
+
+### Runner Changes Required
+
+The runner correction must include:
+
+1. add the new targets to `TARGET_TABLE`
+2. extend the stable execution order used by `all`
+3. add per-target overrides only when a schema actually needs one
+4. preserve the current safety checks for output directories
+5. keep generation reproducible from `src/`
+
+### Verification Changes Required
+
+Issue `#12` must expand its verification section so it no longer stops at the
+three core packages.
+
+The corrected verification must include:
+
+1. import checks for the new generated packages
+2. smoke parsing where feasible for:
+   - `ReferenceTables.xml`
+   - `Subtype_Spa.xml`
+   - `Entity.xml`
+   - `Thesaurus.xml`
+3. documented exceptions when preserved repository layout or source-package
+   drift blocks direct parse success
+
+### Test Changes Required
+
+The following existing test modules must be expanded:
+
+- `tests/test_xsdata_runner_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_xsdata_runner_smoke.py`
+
+The corrected tests must verify:
+
+1. the new target names are resolvable
+2. the runner command is built correctly for each new target

+   coverage
+4. failures caused by documented source-package drift are recorded as known
+   behavior, not hidden
+
+### Issue `#12` Documentation Corrections Required
+
+The issue document for `#12` must be updated so it clearly distinguishes:
+
+- core structural bindings already implemented
+- auxiliary structural bindings still missing but now required by corrected scope
+
+Its impact-on-future-issues section must also state that later semantic work

+2. `uv run pytest tests/test_xsdata_runner_smoke.py -v`
+3. direct import of all generated auxiliary packages
+4. any successful auxiliary parse smoke checks that the preserved package layout
+   allows

+

+- issue `#14` should assume structural visibility of the auxiliary families, not
+  only prose documentation about them
+- issue `#16` must include regression coverage for auxiliary-target generation

+# Hotfix 5 - Normalization Resolution Layer For Auxiliary Reference Sources
+
+## Summary
+
+Hotfix `#5` records the normalization retrofit required after hotfix `#3`
+showed that `ManualCodeEntry.manual_reference_table` points to several kinds of
+machine-readable sources, not only to opaque strings awaiting later manual
+interpretation.
+
+Issue `#13` successfully normalized `SpecificationManual.xml` and
+`CVNTreeModel.xml`, but it deliberately stopped before resolving the technical
+backing of manual reference tables against:
+
+- `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- `Subtype_Spa.xml`
+- `Entity.xml`
+- `Thesaurus*.xml`
+- repository-derived `UNESCO_CODES.xml`
+
+This hotfix documents exactly how issue `#13` must be extended without breaking
+its already validated core baseline.
+
+## Motivation
+
+The current normalization layer is structurally correct but semantically too
+shallow for the updated repository understanding.
+
+Today the code extracts:
+
+- `manual_reference_table`
+
+But it does not yet compute:
+
+- whether that reference resolves to `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- whether it is subtype-backed through `Subtypes.xsd`
+- whether it points to a side-package registry such as `Entity`
+- whether it points to a thesaurus
+- whether it is unresolved from the package alone
+
+That gap would force issue `#14` to rebuild source resolution logic from scratch
+instead of consuming a stable normalized layer.
+
+## Scope Of This Hotfix
+
+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
+
+It does not itself:
+
+- modify normalization code
+- change tests
+- add new runtime behavior
+
+It defines the required corrective work for issue `#13`.
+
+## Issues Affected
+
+- issue `#13`
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#13`
+
+Issue `#13` should remain marked as completed for the core normalization layer,
+but its document and implementation plan must now be expanded to include an
+additive resolution layer over auxiliary references.
+
+### Contract Changes Required
+
+The normalization contract in `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_types.py` must be
+extended with additive fields rather than by replacing the current structures.
+
+At minimum, the normalization output needs a typed representation for:
+
+1. reference resolution status
+2. resolved source family
+3. resolved source artifact name
+4. serialization pattern classification
+5. semantic reference kind
+6. subtype-backing flag or subtype metadata
+
+The design must preserve backward compatibility for current consumers of:
+
+- `ManualCodeEntry`
+- `NormalizedCodeEntry`
+- `NormalizationResult`
+
+### New Types Required
+
+Issue `#13` should add typed structures equivalent in intent to the following:
+
+- a reference-source enum or constrained type
+- a serialization-pattern enum or constrained type
+- a reference-resolution record attached to manual entries or normalized entries
+
+The exact names may vary, but the contract must support these categories:
+
+1. direct `ReferenceTables` table
+2. subtype-backed table
+3. side-package registry
+4. side-package thesaurus
+5. hierarchical thematic table
+6. unresolved manual-only reference
+7. technically present but under-traced table
+
+### New Hand-Maintained Modules Required
+
+Issue `#13` currently spreads normalization across a small flat set of modules.
+That remains acceptable, but the following new responsibilities must be added
+under `src/cvn_codegen/`:
+
+- loading and indexing of `ReferenceTables.xml`
+- loading and indexing of `Subtype_Spa.xml`
+- loading and indexing of `Entity.xml` where needed for source classification
+- loading and indexing of `Thesaurus*.xml` where needed for source
+  classification
+- resolution of `manual_reference_table` against those sources
+- classification of serialization patterns from machine-readable metadata
+
+This can be implemented either as new dedicated modules or as a small
+subpackage, but the logic must stay outside `src/generated/`.
+
+### Orchestration Changes Required
+
+`build_normalization_result(...)` in `src/cvn_codegen/normalization.py` must be
+expanded so the final normalized result includes auxiliary-reference resolution.
+
+The corrected orchestration must:
+
+1. keep the current code-overlap logic unchanged
+2. keep the current `xml_path` logic unchanged
+3. build auxiliary indexes from machine-readable source files
+4. resolve each `manual_reference_table` deterministically
+5. attach the resolution result to the normalized output
+6. preserve source traceability for every resolved reference
+
+### Mismatch And Limitation Reporting Changes Required
+
+`src/cvn_codegen/normalization_report.py` and
+`NormalizationMismatchKind` must be extended so the normalization layer can
+explicitly report the new source-resolution findings.
+
+At minimum, the corrected mismatch taxonomy must support:
+
+- unresolved manual reference
+- ambiguous auxiliary resolution
+- subtype-backed reference lacking expected subtype support
+- technically present but under-traced table
+
+Known repository cases that must be represented explicitly:
+
+- `CVN_AGENCY_C` as unresolved manual-only reference
+- `CVN_INTERVENTION_A` as technically present but currently under-traced
+- `CVN_PRUEBA` as technically present but currently under-traced
+
+### Test Changes Required
+
+The following current tests must be expanded or complemented:
+
+- `tests/test_manual_metadata_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_normalization_report_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_normalization_unit.py`
+
+The corrected test scope must verify at minimum:
+
+1. direct table resolution from `manual_reference_table`
+2. recognition of subtype-backed tables
+3. recognition of side-package registry references
+4. recognition of thesaurus references
+5. unresolved manual-only classification
+6. preservation of the current overlap baseline counts from issue `#13`
+
+### Documentation Corrections Required For Issue `#13`
+
+The issue document for `#13` must be updated so it clearly distinguishes two
+layers:
+
+1. completed core normalization of manual/tree sources
+2. pending auxiliary-reference resolution enrichment required by hotfix `#5`
+
+The issue must no longer imply that `manual_reference_table` is sufficient as a
+final semantic input by itself.
+
+## Files Expected To Change When Applying This Hotfix
+
+When hotfix `#5` is implemented for real, the minimum expected file set is:
+
+- `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_types.py`
+- `src/cvn_codegen/normalization.py`
+- `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_report.py`
+- one or more new modules under `src/cvn_codegen/` for auxiliary-source loading
+  and resolution
+- `tests/test_manual_metadata_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_normalization_report_unit.py`
+- `tests/test_normalization_unit.py`
+- `docs/roadmap/issues/issue-13-normalization.md`
+- `docs/context/current_status.md`
+- `docs/roadmap/cvn_generation_roadmap.md`
+- `docs/pipeline/known_limitations.md` if new resolution limits are discovered
+
+## Verification Strategy When Implemented
+
+The implementation session that applies this hotfix should verify at minimum:
+
+1. `uv run pytest tests/test_manual_metadata_unit.py -v`
+2. `uv run pytest tests/test_normalization_report_unit.py -v`
+3. `uv run pytest tests/test_normalization_unit.py -v`
+4. preservation of the validated baseline counts from issue `#13`
+5. correct classification of the documented special cases from hotfix `#3`
+
+## Impact On Future Issues
+
+- issue `#14` should consume resolved auxiliary-reference metadata instead of
+  re-deriving the source-of-truth rules from prose documents
+- issue `#15` can generate different domain shapes for enums, registries,
+  thesauri, and subtype-backed families from normalized data rather than from ad
+  hoc logic
+- issue `#16` must include regression tests for reference-resolution behavior
+- issue `#17` must document normalization as a richer stage than simple manual
+  and tree cross-indexing
+
+## Status
+
+- Status: documented as required corrective work
+- Implementation state: pending

+# Hotfix 6 - Roadmap Realignment For Auxiliary Catalog Semantic Integration
+
+## Summary
+
+Hotfix `#6` records the roadmap correction required after hotfixes `#4` and
+`#5`.
+
+The original roadmap for issues `#14` to `#17` assumed that the repository would
+reach semantic work after only two technical preparation stages:
+
+1. structural bindings for the core schemas
+2. normalization of `SpecificationManual.xml` and `CVNTreeModel.xml`
+
+After the auxiliary source-package analysis from hotfix `#3`, that sequencing is
+no longer sufficient. Future issues must explicitly incorporate the auxiliary
+catalog families and the resolution layer built over them.
+
+This hotfix does not implement those future issues. It documents exactly how the
+already created issue set must be replanned.
+
+## Motivation
+
+If the roadmap is left unchanged:
+
+- issue `#14` would try to define semantic policy over incomplete normalized
+  inputs
+- issue `#15` would likely mix discovery work with generation work
+- issue `#16` would test a pipeline that still lacks the now-documented
+  auxiliary-source integration stage
+- issue `#17` would document an incomplete workflow
+
+## Scope Of This Hotfix
+
+This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
+
+It does not itself:
+
+- implement issue `#14`
+- implement issue `#15`
+- implement issue `#16`
+- implement issue `#17`
+
+It defines the required replanning for those issues and for the roadmap-level
+documents that describe them.
+
+## Issues Affected
+
+- issue `#8`
+- issue `#14`
+- issue `#15`
+- issue `#16`
+- issue `#17`
+- issue `#25` as CI impact only
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#8`
+
+The epic summary in issue `#8` must be updated because its current state and
+integration checkpoints are historically outdated.
+
+The corrected epic narrative must state that the technical foundation now has
+three preparation layers before domain-model generation can proceed safely:
+
+1. core and auxiliary structural bindings
+2. core normalization of manual and tree sources
+3. auxiliary reference-resolution enrichment over normalized manual references
+
+The epic current-status section must also stop saying that issue `#13` is the
+next planned issue.
+
+## Required Changes To Issue `#14`
+
+Issue `#14` needs the largest scope correction among pending issues.
+
+### New Required Input Assumption
+
+Issue `#14` must no longer assume that semantic policy begins from only:
+
+- manual type
+- multiplicity
+- `manual_reference_table`
+- `xml_path`
+
+It must now explicitly consume the enriched normalization output from hotfix
+`#5`, including resolved source family and serialization-pattern metadata.
+
+### New Decision Areas Required
+
+The issue plan for `#14` must explicitly classify references into at least these
+semantic kinds:
+
+1. compact enum-like table
+2. compact scale or measure table
+3. identifier-type table
+4. scope table
+5. subtype-backed controlled family
+6. hierarchical thematic classification
+7. side-package registry
+8. side-package thesaurus or vocabulary
+9. unresolved manual-only reference
+10. technically present but under-traced table
+
+### New Policy Outputs Required
+
+The final semantic policy for issue `#14` must define:

1: # Hotfix 4 - Structural Scope Correction For Auxiliary Source Package Artifacts
2: 
3: ## Summary
4: 
5: Hotfix `#4` records the structural-generation retrofit required after the source
6: package documentation expansion from hotfix `#3`.
7: 
8: The repository already implemented the core structural layer for:
9: 
10: - `CVN.xsd`
11: - `SpecificationManual.xsd`
12: - `CVNTreeModel_v1.0.xsd`
13: 
14: But the canonical package also contains machine-readable auxiliary families that
15: were left outside the structural generation plan:
16: 
17: - `ReferenceTables.xsd`
18: - `Subtypes.xsd`
19: - `Entity_v1.4.xsd`
20: - `Thesaurus.xsd`
21: - repository-derived `UNESCOCodes.xsd`
22: 
23: This hotfix does not implement those changes. It documents exactly how issues
24: `#11` and `#12` must be corrected so the repository baseline matches the real
25: source package scope.
26: 
27: ## Motivation
28: 
29: Hotfix `#3` established that the canonical CVN package is not only the core
30: manual, tree model, and CVN XSDs. It also contains auxiliary catalogs and
31: supporting schemas that are relevant to later semantic work.
32: 
33: Without this retrofit:
34: 
35: - issue `#14` would define semantic rules over incomplete technical inputs
36: - issue `#15` would need to model external catalogs without generated or
37:   reproducible structural access to their schemas
38: - issue `#16` would test only the core package and leave the auxiliary layer
39:   outside regression coverage
40: 
41: ## Scope Of This Hotfix
42: 
43: This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
44: 
45: It does not itself:
46: 
47: - generate new bindings
48: - change `src/generated/`
49: - modify runner code
50: - modify tests
51: 
52: It defines the required corrective work for already created issues.
53: 
54: ## Issues Affected
55: 
56: - issue `#11`
57: - issue `#12`
58: 
59: ## Required Changes To Issue `#11`
60: 
61: Issue `#11` remains valid as the infrastructure baseline, but its documented
62: scope must be expanded so the reserved repository layout matches the canonical
63: package.
64: 
65: ### Repository Layout Changes Required
66: 
67: The infrastructure documentation and intended layout must explicitly reserve
68: destination packages for the auxiliary structural families under
69: `src/generated/`.
70: 
71: At minimum, the repository must treat these as planned generated packages:
72: 
73: - `src/generated/reference_tables/`
74: - `src/generated/subtypes/`
75: - `src/generated/entity/`
76: - `src/generated/thesaurus/`
77: 
78: Optional but recommended if the isolated extracted artifact remains part of the
79: repository contract:
80: 
81: - `src/generated/unesco_codes/`
82: 
83: ### Hand-Maintained Pipeline Areas Required
84: 
85: Issue `#11` should also be retroactively understood as reserving space for
86: hand-maintained support logic dedicated to auxiliary artifacts under
87: `src/cvn_codegen/`.
88: 
89: The expected future module families are:
90: 
91: - structural loading helpers for auxiliary XML/XSD families
92: - resolution helpers that connect `manual_reference_table` values to their
93:   backing artifacts
94: - normalization or indexing helpers for side-package catalogs
95: 
96: ### Documentation Changes Required
97: 
98: Issue `#11` should be updated so its repository layout and future-impact section
99: explicitly state that the infrastructure baseline must support both:
100: 
101: - core structural bindings
102: - auxiliary catalog structural bindings
103: 
104: ## Required Changes To Issue `#12`
105: 
106: Issue `#12` is the main issue that needs corrective scope expansion.
107: 
108: Its current plan generated structural bindings only for the three core XSD
109: concerns. The corrected scope must cover the auxiliary schemas that carry
110: machine-readable catalog semantics.
111: 
112: ### New Generation Targets Required
113: 
114: `src/cvn_codegen/xsdata_runner.py` must be extended so `TARGET_TABLE` and the
115: supported target list include at least:
116: 
117: - `reference_tables`
118: - `subtypes`
119: - `entity`
120: - `thesaurus`
121: 
122: Optional but recommended if treated as a first-class repository artifact:
123: 
124: - `unesco_codes`
125: 
126: ### Expected Target Mapping
127: 
128: The corrected target mapping should follow this pattern:
129: 
130: - `ReferenceTables.xsd` -> `generated.reference_tables`
131: - `Subtypes.xsd` -> `generated.subtypes`
132: - `Entity_v1.4.xsd` -> `generated.entity`
133: - `Thesaurus.xsd` -> `generated.thesaurus`
134: - `UNESCOCodes.xsd` -> `generated.unesco_codes`
135: 
136: ### Runner Changes Required
137: 
138: The runner correction must include:
139: 
140: 1. add the new targets to `TARGET_TABLE`
141: 2. extend the stable execution order used by `all`
142: 3. add per-target overrides only when a schema actually needs one
143: 4. preserve the current safety checks for output directories
144: 5. keep generation reproducible from `src/`
145: 
146: ### Verification Changes Required
147: 
148: Issue `#12` must expand its verification section so it no longer stops at the
149: three core packages.
150: 
151: The corrected verification must include:
152: 
153: 1. import checks for the new generated packages
154: 2. smoke parsing where feasible for:
155:    - `ReferenceTables.xml`
156:    - `Subtype_Spa.xml`
157:    - `Entity.xml`
158:    - `Thesaurus.xml`
159: 3. documented exceptions when preserved repository layout or source-package
160:    drift blocks direct parse success
161: 
162: ### Test Changes Required
163: 
164: The following existing test modules must be expanded:
165: 
166: - `tests/test_xsdata_runner_unit.py`
167: - `tests/test_xsdata_runner_smoke.py`
168: 
169: The corrected tests must verify:
170: 
171: 1. the new target names are resolvable
172: 2. the runner command is built correctly for each new target
173: 3. generation produces Python files for at least one auxiliary target in smoke
174:    coverage
175: 4. failures caused by documented source-package drift are recorded as known
176:    behavior, not hidden
177: 
178: ### Issue `#12` Documentation Corrections Required
179: 
180: The issue document for `#12` must be updated so it clearly distinguishes:
181: 
182: - core structural bindings already implemented
183: - auxiliary structural bindings still missing but now required by corrected scope
184: 
185: Its impact-on-future-issues section must also state that later semantic work
186: depends on both core and auxiliary structural visibility.
187: 
188: ## Files Expected To Change When Applying This Hotfix
189:

191: 
192: - `src/cvn_codegen/xsdata_runner.py`
193: - `tests/test_xsdata_runner_unit.py`

202: ## Verification Strategy When Implemented

1: # Hotfix 5 - Normalization Resolution Layer For Auxiliary Reference Sources
2: 
3: ## Summary
4: 
5: Hotfix `#5` records the normalization retrofit required after hotfix `#3`
6: showed that `ManualCodeEntry.manual_reference_table` points to several kinds of
7: machine-readable sources, not only to opaque strings awaiting later manual
8: interpretation.
9: 
10: Issue `#13` successfully normalized `SpecificationManual.xml` and
11: `CVNTreeModel.xml`, but it deliberately stopped before resolving the technical
12: backing of manual reference tables against:
13: 
14: - `ReferenceTables.xml`
15: - `Subtype_Spa.xml`
16: - `Entity.xml`
17: - `Thesaurus*.xml`
18: - repository-derived `UNESCO_CODES.xml`
19: 
20: This hotfix documents exactly how issue `#13` must be extended without breaking
21: its already validated core baseline.
22: 
23: ## Motivation
24: 
25: The current normalization layer is structurally correct but semantically too
26: shallow for the updated repository understanding.
27: 
28: Today the code extracts:
29: 
30: - `manual_reference_table`
31: 
32: But it does not yet compute:
33: 
34: - whether that reference resolves to `ReferenceTables.xml`
35: - whether it is subtype-backed through `Subtypes.xsd`
36: - whether it points to a side-package registry such as `Entity`
37: - whether it points to a thesaurus
38: - whether it is unresolved from the package alone
39: 
40: That gap would force issue `#14` to rebuild source resolution logic from scratch
41: instead of consuming a stable normalized layer.
42: 
43: ## Scope Of This Hotfix
44: 
45: This hotfix is a planning and correction record.
46: 
47: It does not itself:
48: 
49: - modify normalization code
50: - change tests
51: - add new runtime behavior
52: 
53: It defines the required corrective work for issue `#13`.
54: 
55: ## Issues Affected
56: 
57: - issue `#13`
58: 
59: ## Required Changes To Issue `#13`
60: 
61: Issue `#13` should remain marked as completed for the core normalization layer,
62: but its document and implementation plan must now be expanded to include an
63: additive resolution layer over auxiliary references.
64: 
65: ### Contract Changes Required
66: 
67: The normalization contract in `src/cvn_codegen/normalization_types.py` must be
68: extended with additive fields rather than by replacing the current structures.
69: 
70: At minimum, the normalization output needs a typed representation for:
71: 
72: 1. reference resolution status
73: 2. resolved source family
74: 3. resolved source artifact name
75: 4. serialization pattern classification
76: 5. semantic reference kind
77: 6. subtype-backing flag or subtype metadata
78: 
79: The design must preserve backward compatibility for current consumers of:
80: 
81: - `ManualCodeEntry`
82: - `NormalizedCodeEntry`
83: - `NormalizationResult`
84: 
85: ### New Types Required
86: 
87: Issue `#13` should add typed structures equivalent in intent to the following:
88: 
89: - a reference-source enum or constrained type
90: - a serialization-pattern enum or constrained type
91: - a reference-resolution record attached to manual entries or normalized entries
92: 
93: The exact names may vary, but the contract must support these categories:
94: 
95: 1. direct `ReferenceTables` table
96: 2. subtype-backed table
97: 3. side-package registry
98: 4. side-package thesaurus
99: 5. hierarchical thematic table
100: 6. unresolved manual-only reference
101: 7. technically present but under-traced table
102: 
103: ### New Hand-Maintained Modules Required
104: 
105: Issue `#13` currently spreads normalization across a small flat set of modules.
